Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating a urinary tract infection, likely complicated given the patient’s age and findings. Low specific gravity may suggest impaired urine concentrating ability. Prompt clinical evaluation and targeted antibiotic therapy are recommended.
